title: Romantic Pink Oval Crystal & Enamel Ring
storyHtml:
A soft pink oval cradled between panels of blush enamel and sparkling pavé. Tender and a touch regal — the ring you reach for when you want to feel like the main character.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Oval-cut 5A pink zircon, pavé clear zircon & pink enamel
